searchText: Is there documentation of the "ceremony" for the deployment of the Eth2 deposit contract, i.e. describing system isolation, ensuring that the bytecode generated/deployed is what you expect it to be, that the address is properly communicated, etc? Is this something that is going to be communicated to the community? Not that it should be automated or anything, but it may be a good idea to have at least its basic structure known, to get feedback into the process and promote good practices. A certain level of security by obscurity may also be appropriate.
